facts.fact: 她无声地对他比口型："你在这儿干什么？"
facts.anchor: What are you doing here? I mouthed at him.

facts.fact: "浴室里的 Rowan"把脸往门缝里又挤进去一点
facts.anchor: Rowan-in-the-bathroom pushed his face further into the gap in the door.

facts.fact: 他说想来看看她，见门开着、担心出了事就进来，然后听见"那个东西"，就跑去躲起来；声音压得低、在抖，问"那是什么？为什么它听起来像我的声音？"
facts.anchor: “I wanted to check in on you. Then I saw the door was open and I was worried something had happened, so I stepped inside and then I heard that… thing… and I ran and hid.”

facts.fact: 她胸口发紧、手心出汗：全是她的错，她得把他弄出去——可她到底怎么把他弄出去
facts.anchor: My chest went tight and my hands started to sweat. This was all my fault. I had to get him out. How in the hell was I going to get him out?

facts.fact: 楼下刚下几级台阶的地方，那个声音喊："你还好吗？"
facts.anchor: “Are you alright?” the voice called from just down the stairs.

facts.fact: 楼梯最下面那级在黑暗里吱呀作响
facts.anchor: The bottom step of the stairs creaked in the dark.

facts.fact: 浴室里的 Rowan 朝她伸出手
facts.anchor: Rowan-in-the-bathroom reached out his hand to me.

facts.fact: 她伸过去要抓，一只手从斧柄上松开，然后停住了
facts.anchor: I went to grab it, taking one hand off the axe, then stopped.

facts.fact: 她想起那句"她会猎捕你"
facts.anchor: “She will hunt you.”

facts.fact: 她想起 Fergus 讲的故事：楼下有一个妈妈，浴室里也有一个——你选哪个？
facts.anchor: I remembered Fergus’s story. One mum downstairs. One in the bathroom. Who do you choose?

facts.fact: 她把两只手都放回斧柄上
facts.anchor: I put both hands back on the axe.

facts.fact: 他先是惊慌，然后慢慢变成震惊
facts.anchor: Rowan-in-the-bathroom looked at me, panicked at first, then slowly shocked.

facts.fact: 她后退，他喊："Tamsin！你疯了吗？"
facts.anchor: “Tamsin! Are you nuts?”

facts.fact: 他的脸扭成一团怒火；他喊："你会把我们俩都害死！"
facts.anchor: His face curdled into anger.

facts.fact: 她说："对不起，但你不是 Rowan。"
facts.anchor: “I’m sorry,” I said, “but you’re not Rowan.”

facts.fact: 他靠着浴室门瘫下去，眼睛周围的皮肤抽动着
facts.anchor: He sank against the bathroom door. The skin around his eyes twitched.

facts.fact: 房子突然静止下来，像一只上满弦、等着弹起的捕兽夹那样静止
facts.anchor: The house was suddenly still in the way a loaded, waiting, spring trap is still.

facts.fact: 他的脸塌了下去——若不是知道得清楚，她会把那读成失望、绝望
facts.anchor: His face sagged.

facts.fact: 直到第一小片碎玻璃从眼皮底下探出来、把眼角皮肤顶得皱起，她才明白那不是抽搐，而是在"装满"，像一只零钱包
facts.anchor: It was only when the first, tiny shard of glass peeked out from under its eyelids, puckering the skin at the corners, that I realised it wasn’t twitching but filling, like a coin purse.

facts.fact: 一股墨水似的碎玻璃从眼珠底下滚出来，挂在眼皮薄薄的皮肤上
facts.anchor: An inky stream of splintered glass tumbled from under its eyeballs, catching in the thin skin of its eyelids.

facts.fact: 它的嘴张成一个完美的黑色"哦"，圆得毫无自然可言，然后发出一声刺穿墙壁的尖叫
facts.anchor: Its mouth pulled into a perfect dark ‘oh’, too round to feel natural in any way, and shook the walls with a piercing scream.

facts.fact: 她在最高一级滑了一下、脚下绊住，摔下楼梯，跌进下面那片黑暗——那个声音正在那里等她
facts.anchor: I slipped on the top step, fumbled on my own feet and tumbled down the stairs, down into the dark below where the voice was waiting for me.
